baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated perfect verbs فَكَّرَ and قَدَّرَ in 74:18.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated mental turning culminates in arranging the matter by estimate, so the second verb converts reflection into a designed result.

activation_trace.role: Its image of the heart repeatedly turning a matter supplies the iterative mental phase.
Its image of arranging by estimate and deliberation supplies the conversion of reflection into an engineered outcome.

changed_reading.after: He kept turning the matter over, then deliberately proportioned and arranged a result.

baseline_models.mechanism: Concern or felt stake drives a calculation aimed at effective control; the thought is interested rather than detached.

activation_trace.role: Its image of having a need or concern in a matter makes the thinking personally invested.
Its image of capacity reaching effective control makes the estimate an attempted instrument of mastery.

changed_reading.after: He thought from a position of concern and calculated toward control of the matter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from فَكَّرَ to the constrictive branch of قَدَّرَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mental recurrence ends by forcing the object into a narrower measure, treating thought as reduction rather than discovery.

activation_trace.role: Its image of repeatedly turning a matter supplies the processing that precedes reduction.
Its image of narrowing something to a scant measure supplies constriction as the product of thought.

changed_reading.after: He mentally worked the matter until he could compress it into a limiting frame.

context_deltas.mechanism: Accumulated and extended provision generates expectation of further increase; resistance to the signs then channels that invested expectation into calculated response-making at 74:18.

activation_trace.role: Concern or need makes the focus thought an interested calculation.
Arrangement by estimate supplies the deliberate response produced from that interest.
Its image of possessing and multiplying wealth supplies the material base of the subject's expectations.
Its image of connected increase makes the provision feel extendable rather than complete.
Its image of the heart's covetous hope supplies the desire that drives the calculation.
Its image of seeking an increment turns prior extension into an active demand for more.
Its image of swerving from straightness and resisting truth supplies the oppositional direction of the design.

structural_cues: 74:12-16 move from extended wealth through desire for increase to resistance immediately before the focus.
The focus opens with إِنَّهُ, retaining the previously described subject and causal pressure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extension, desire for increase, resistance, and then thought-plus-estimate; I infer an arrow from entitlement to rhetorical calculation, while a live alternative is that the material sequence characterizes the subject without motivating his design.

changed_reading.after: An endowed subject expecting continued increase performs interested arithmetic, calculating a response to signs that block his expectation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The estimate is repeated twice as an object of interrogative scrutiny, each time under a death-curse or destruction formula, exposing the focus act itself as culpable calibration rather than neutral cognition.

activation_trace.role: Repeated mental turning supplies the process whose result is subsequently scrutinized.
Arrangement by estimate supplies the focus operation repeated in the next two ayat.
Its image of killing or extinguishing life supplies the first severe denunciatory frame around the estimate.
The repeated image of deliberate arrangement makes the method, not only the result, an object of scrutiny.
The repeated killing image doubles the denunciatory pressure.
The second repeated estimate turns a completed act into an exposed, replayed procedure.

structural_cues: 74:19 and 74:20 repeat كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ, with the second introduced by ثُمَّ.
كَيْفَ is branchless in the packet but structurally places the manner of estimating under scrutiny.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies doubled قُتِلَ and doubled كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ; I infer that condemnation targets the crafted procedure and its audacity, while a live alternative is a general curse on the agent with no emphasis on iterative design.

changed_reading.after: He produced a culpable calibration whose very manner is replayed, exposed, and denounced twice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is the hidden drafting phase of a staged production line: mental design proceeds through inspection, embodied reaction, withdrawal and self-elevation, then exits as a spoken public label.

activation_trace.role: Turning the matter over supplies the internal drafting stage.
Calculated arrangement supplies the transition from internal processing toward a fitted output.
Its image of directing sight or insight toward an object supplies an inspection stage after calculation.
Its image of facial contraction under distress supplies visible feedback from the internal process.
Its image of a grim, intensely averse face intensifies the embodied evaluation.
Its image of presenting the back and turning away supplies withdrawal as the selected posture.
Its image of greatness and pride supplies self-elevation as the stance paired with withdrawal.
Its image of emitting speech supplies the public output of the preceding internal and bodily stages.
Its image of diversion and deception supplies the content of the manufactured label.
Its image of transmitted report makes inherited circulation part of the final label's explanatory force.

structural_cues: ثُمَّ introduces each stage in 74:21-23 before فَقَالَ marks output in 74:24.
The focus's two coordinated perfect verbs precede a sequence of perception, face, posture, and speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered stages and their final utterance; I infer a production pipeline in which each stage helps fashion the verdict, while a live alternative is that the sequence merely reports successive reactions after an already finished decision.

changed_reading.after: 74:18 opens a staged manufacture of a public verdict, moving from hidden drafting through inspection and performed posture into speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The constrictive branch of قَدَّرَ is realized in two restrictive labels: the object is compressed into deception transmitted from elsewhere and then into speech bounded by the visible human category.

activation_trace.role: Mental recurrence supplies the processing that produces a reductive classification.
Narrowing to a scant measure supplies the mechanism by which the object is reduced to a small explanatory frame.
Emitted speech makes the reduced frame explicit and socially available.
Diversion and deception provide the first narrowing label.
Transmission of a report bounds the claimed source of the object.
Its image of speech defining a thing's limit supplies classification as boundary-setting.
Its image of exposed skin and visible surface makes 'human' a surface-level category imposed on the object.

structural_cues: 74:24 and 74:25 use parallel restrictive constructions beginning إِنْ هَذَا إِلَّا.
The two labels follow the focus calculation as its explicit outputs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies constriction, two restrictive labels, boundary-defining speech, and visible surface; I infer an arrow from estimation to reductive taxonomy, while a live alternative is ordinary planning followed by labels whose roots carry no shared constrictive mechanism.

changed_reading.after: He reduced the object to a bounded taxonomy, first as transmitted deception and then as merely surface-level human speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later exact count is explicitly made a test that separates settled knowledge from disturbed doubt; this recasts the focus estimate as one possible human handling of measure, aimed at control rather than reception.

activation_trace.role: Measure reaching a thing's limit anchors the focus act in quantification and delimitation.
Arrangement by calculation makes the focus a human attempt to organize what is presented.
The literal number nine supplies the first component of the exact count.
The literal number ten completes the stated count and makes measure overt.
Its image of enumerating what is counted identifies number itself as the operative object.
Its image of assaying metal or persons turns the count from information into an epistemic test.
Its image of stable knowledge after doubt supplies one possible result of encountering the count.
Its image of disturbed doubt supplies the competing result of the same encounter.
Its image of a stated comparison supplies the object about which resistant speakers demand an intention.

structural_cues: The exact number in 74:30 is immediately interpreted by the extended response map in 74:31.
74:31 places certainty, faith, doubt, questioning speech, guidance, and error around the same count.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact count and explicitly divergent epistemic effects; I infer a contrast between receptive measure and the focus subject's controlling calibration, while a live alternative is only a broad numerical echo with no direct contrast to 74:18.

changed_reading.after: His estimate is a failed mode of meeting measure: calculation is used to master the sign instead of letting the measured datum test the knower.

context_deltas.mechanism: The private cognitive maneuver at 74:18 becomes the first, internal form of a later avoidance pattern: turning aside develops into recoil and flight, then into a demand that the reminder arrive as individually opened sheets, while fear of the later outcome remains absent.

activation_trace.role: Repeated mental turning supplies an internal maneuver that can precede outward avoidance.
Calculated arrangement supplies the crafted rationale through which avoidance first takes cognitive form.
Its image of a reminder that causes recollection identifies what the later subjects avoid.
Its image of turning one's side supplies the first outward geometry of avoidance.
Its image of recoiling and distancing from a thing converts side-turning into active separation.
Its image of escape and flight carries the avoidance pattern to full bodily withdrawal.
Its image of a written sheet supplies the individualized substitute demanded after flight from the reminder.
Its image of opening and spreading makes the demanded sheets separately exposed and available.
Its image of alarm at expected harm identifies the absent restraint beneath the evasive demands.

structural_cues: 74:49 asks about turning from the reminder, 74:50-51 render recoil as flight, and 74:52-53 replace response with demand and denial of fear.
بَلْ pivots twice in 74:52-53, exposing a motive beneath the stated demand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later sequence from reminder through side-turning, recoil, flight, personalized sheets, and absent fear; I infer that the focus calculation is an internal precursor of this pattern, while a live alternative is that the later plural group need not generalize the singular subject's cognition.

changed_reading.before: 74:18 depicts a self-contained act of reasoning.
changed_reading.after: The reasoning is cognitive evasion in embryo: a crafted counter-frame later expands into bodily recoil, flight, and demands for a customized mode of address.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement contrasts self-enclosed thought and measurement with responsive remembrance: willing recollection remains bounded by divine willing and opens toward protection and forgiveness rather than control.

activation_trace.role: Repeated mental turning anchors the closed cognitive loop being contrasted.
Capacity reaching control supplies mastery as the focus loop's goal.
Its image of willing directed toward a thing supplies voluntary orientation toward recollection.
Its image of bringing something to presence after forgetfulness supplies receptive cognition as the alternative to fabrication.
Its image of placing oneself within protection supplies the posture reached by receptive remembrance.
Its image of covering fault and shielding its bearer from effects supplies the restorative horizon absent from controlling calculation.

structural_cues: 74:54 names the discourse a reminder, and 74:55-56 repeat the remembrance root while nesting human willing under divine willing.
The final ayah joins protective restraint and forgiveness rather than ending with cognition alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies thought aimed at control and a closing sequence of willing, remembering, protection, and forgiveness; I infer a contrast between fabricated and receptive cognition, while a live alternative is that the close addresses response generally without commenting on the specific thinking in 74:18.

changed_reading.before: The fault lies simply in thinking and estimating.
changed_reading.after: The fault lies in a closed loop of thought aimed at mastery; the closing alternative is cognition that becomes receptive remembrance and accepts its bounded agency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from خ ل ق to ق د ر and must not equate the two agents or acts; it remains anchored because the packet gives 'measuring and proportioning' as a branch image for خَلَقْتُ immediately upstream and measure as the focus verb's image; downstream prose should present it only as a possible structural irony in which a measured creature assumes the posture of measurer.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَدَّرَ at focus word 3, read against the measuring branch carried by خَلَقْتُ in 74:11.

activation_trace.role: Its image of measure reaching a thing's limit makes the subject an active measurer in the focus.
Its image of measuring and proportioning a thing makes the same subject first appear as one who was himself measured in creation.

changed_reading.before: A created person makes a plan.
changed_reading.after: The sequence may stage an ironic role reversal: one introduced as measured in creation now tries to occupy the controlling position of measurer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps physical burden and steep ascent onto cognition without an explicit causal link; it remains anchored in the immediate adjacency of 74:17 to فَكَّرَ and the constrictive branch of قَدَّرَ; downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial analogy for the mental maneuver, not as a lexical definition or fixed chronology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَكَّرَ and the narrowing image of قَدَّرَ immediately after the burdened ascent of 74:17.

activation_trace.role: Its image of repeatedly turning a matter supplies movement within a mental problem-space.
Its image of constricting to a scant measure supplies the narrow route produced by that movement.
Its image of oppressive burden supplies the pressure under which the mental route is imagined.
Its image of a steep obstacle and hardship supplies the spatial terrain mirrored by constrictive calculation.

changed_reading.before: He mentally devised an answer after a threat of hardship.
changed_reading.after: His thought can be pictured as strained route-making under a steep burden, repeatedly turning until it cuts the matter down to a narrow passage.

strongest_changes: The doubled قَدَّرَ under doubled denunciation converts neutral planning into exposed, culpable calibration.
The ثُمَّ sequence from looking through posture to speech makes 74:18 the hidden drafting stage of a public verdict.
Upstream extension and desire make the calculation interested, while downstream recoil makes it the cognitive beginning of evasion.
The closing remembrance sequence distinguishes controlling cognition from receptive cognition rather than condemning thought as such.
summary.what_was_special: The exact repetition of the focus's ق د ر root, the staged bodily-to-verbal sequence, and the branch-level images of measure, control, and constriction supported several coexisting mechanisms without requiring one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether قَدَّرَ foregrounds orderly planning, limit-setting, attempted mastery, or constriction in this occurrence.
Whether the later plural avoidance sequence intentionally generalizes the singular focus subject's cognitive pattern.
Whether the creator-measurer mirror is deliberate structural irony or only a productive cross-root resonance.
How strongly material entitlement motivates the focus calculation rather than merely characterizing its agent.
